notes: Outstanding table is indexed by source (256 entries). A request accepted on the same edge as its D beat counts as matched. If the table already holds that source, the table entry is matched. CHK-009 to CHK-012 are disabled once a request with i_a_intg_flip=1 is accepted, until reset. The CHK-013 hit counter counts every cycle out of reset. I did not compile this in Verilator.
